verdict.rationale: Slack ships an official CLI for building/managing Slack apps (slack-docs-9, slack-docs-1, slack-docs-26/40/60, slack-probe-4), with quickstart guides supporting Bolt frameworks in multiple languages, tied into an AI-native workflow (docs mention creating agents via 'slack create' and building AI-integrated apps). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the CLI itself (community evidence in the pack is unrelated to CLI usage) and more detail on AI-native-specific CLI commands beyond scaffolding.
